question: Does Phala Cloud still publish an unconditional free CVM tier or welcome credit that a new workspace can claim without adding a card, and on which first-party page?
why: The 2026-11-25 first-party pricing page states only that 'Some workspaces are offered a welcome credit when they add a card'; the two captures in the packet (phala.com/pricing and the quick-start) state no free CPU or GPU tier. The recorded USD 0.06/hour and USD 4.40/hour rates are not stated on any captured page.
